question: 10 kg of superior quality of rice is mixed with 5 kg of inferior quality of rice. The prices of superior quality and inferior quality rice are ₹85 and ₹46, respectively. Find the average price per kg of the mixture.
solution:
**Given:**

Mass of superior rice (m1) = 10 kg

Price of superior rice (p1) = ₹85/kg

Mass of inferior rice (m2) = 5 kg

Price of inferior rice (p2) = ₹46/kg

**Concept:**

Average price = Total cost/Total quantity

Total cost = Quantity × Price
